items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: isolated vehicle sprite for a small fixed-view parking website. Use the provided image as shape and vehicle-identity reference, not as a background. Produce ONE Rolls-Royce Phantom, long formal sedan, silver-white lower body with navy hood and roof, tall upright chrome vertical-slat grille, rectangular headlights, hood ornament, large radial-spoke wheels. Faithful semi-realistic miniature/model-car appearance, very light simplification only, crisp detailed silhouette that reads at 180px. Front three-quarter view facing toward lower LEFT, camera elevated about 20 degrees so the hood and roof are visible; whole vehicle centered with generous margin, no cropping, all visible wheels grounded at consistent level. Preserve distinctive real vehicle geometry and proportions, clean softly lit product render. Transparent background with a restrained soft contact shadow only. No ground plane, scenery, frame, labels, captions, promotional logos outside the vehicle, or extra vehicles. This is a visual exploration derived from a reference; do not invent a 3D asset.
